ios.desc:
PocketSuite is an all-in-one booking app for service professionals. With PocketSuite, you will book more new business, have clients show up on time (and still get paid if they don’t), grow your team, and have new customers sign digital contracts and intake forms. At PocketSuite, there are features built for every client-based business. We also have powerful marketing features to build up more leads and five-star reviews.

Plus, the PocketSuite calendar helps keep any client-based business organized and efficient with color-coded day, week, month, agenda, and map views.

Key Features:

- Scheduling - 

Online booking and scheduling
Map-view calendar with buffer time and directions between mobile appointments
Lead forms and CRM management
Automatically track package usage over appointments & classes
Multi-day appointments/overnights with check-in & check-out
Subscription/ membership management
Color code business appointments

- Messaging -

SMS text client communication and calls from a local business number
Keep your business and personal texting and calls separate 
Automated appointment reminders from a local business number clients can respond to
Dedicated business phone number for texting and calls
Send in-app messages and attachments

- Payments and Invoicing -

Accept credit cards 
Automatically charge cards at the completion of an appointment
Deposits for appointments
Enforceable cancellation policies
Invoices
Tap-to-Pay
Buy-Now-Pay-Later
POS Payments
Sell packages and subscriptions and automatically track usage 

- Marketing -

Smart campaigns for powerful text marketing
Review tools to get more five-star reviews
Get more organic leads from search
Create a booking site that links with websites and all social media
Offer discounts, promotions, and gift certificates
Integrate your booking, ordering and lead pages with Google Analytics and Google Tag Manager

- Team & Staffing  -

Assign jobs to team members
Set roles & permissions
Process payroll
Communicate with your team 
Manage a full team on the platform

- Business Tools -

Digital forms and contracts
Sell products online and track inventory 
Track sales tax
Easy tax tools and business reports

Any client-based business can benefit from PocketSuite!
